source_section: 5.1 TCS — Tax Collected at Source (GST Section 52)
summary: 5.1 TCS — Tax Collected at Source (GST Section 52) Rate: \~1% of net taxable value In data: meeshosettlement.totaltcsamount — negative (debit to seller) Example: On ₹240.95 taxable value → TCS = ₹1.93 (0.8%) to ₹2.47 (1.03%) observed Recovery: Seller claims in GSTR-2A as credit

source_section: 5.2 TDS — Tax Deducted at Source (IT Section 194-O)
summary: 5.2 TDS — Tax Deducted at Source (IT Section 194-O) Rate: 0.1% of gross taxable sale value (confirmed from tdsrate = 0.1000) In data: meeshosettlement.totaltds — negative (debit to seller) Example: On ₹240.95 taxable value → TDS = ₹0.24 Recovery: Seller claims in Form 26AS (annual IT return) Note: 0.1% rate is lower than standard 1% — Meesho uses reduced rate applicable to turnover-compliant sellers

1. Table Overview meeshoreturns is the return tracking and logistics table for Meesho. Unlike meeshoreverse (which is the financial OMS), this table captures the operational detail of the return journey: the product, SKU, category, courier partner, return type, and key dates (dispatch, return initiation, final delivery back to seller). It is sourced from Meesho's logistics return report and is the primary source for return-level SKU and brand attribution. Important: This table uses grouplevelid = 221 (not 22), indicating it belongs to a different seller entity — CODEZ / ARDEUR brands — as evidenced by the SKU prefixes (CBSW, AMJG, CBHO = Codez Boys, Ardeur Mens). source_section: Meesho Brand Mapping — Table Knowledge Base
summary: Meesho Brand Mapping — Table Knowledge Base Schema: zsobserve Table: meeshobrandmapping Last Updated: April 2025 Maintained By: ZenStatement Data Team ---

1. Table Overview meeshobrandmapping is the order-to-brand/SKU enrichment table for Meesho. It resolves the critical gap in meeshosales and meeshoreverse where brand and skuid are always NULL — this table maps each orderid to its brand, SKU, product description, size, MRP, and other product attributes. This is a lookup/dimension table: join it to meeshosales or meeshoreverse on orderid to add brand-level and SKU-level context. It is the only source of brand attribution across the Meesho pipeline. Brands present: Pretty Kraft, BeyBee, Dennis Lingo, High Star, Ishin, Lilpicks — all Mensa portfolio brands sold under grouplevelid = 22. ---

source_section: Table: Meesho Reverse — Table Knowledge Base
summary: Table: Meesho Reverse — Table Knowledge Base Schema: zsobserve Table: meeshoreverse Last Updated: April 2025 Maintained By: ZenStatement Data Team ---

1. Table Overview meeshoreverse is the reverse-order OMS table for Meesho — the mirror of meeshosales for return and cancellation transactions. Every sub-order that was returned by the customer (Return), returned-to-origin by the courier (rto), or cancelled (Cancelled) appears here. The financial structure is identical to meeshosales, enabling symmetric reconciliation of forward and reverse flows. Each row is one reverse sub-order line, carrying the original charged amount, GST, marketplace fees, and freight associated with the return event. The chargedamount represents the original sale price that is now being reversed/refunded. ---

summary: Table: Meesho Forward Expenses — Table Knowledge Base Schema: zsobserve Table: meeshoforwardexpenses Last Updated: April 2025 Maintained By: ZenStatement Data Team ---

1. Table Overview meeshoforwardexpenses is the per-order expense invoice ledger for successfully delivered (forward) orders from Meesho's supplier expense report. For every delivered sub-order, Meesho generates a formal GST-compliant invoice itemising the charges deducted from the seller — primarily logistics (shipping) and the Meesho Mall Platform Fee. Critical finding: netcommission = 0.0 for 100% of records. This confirms Meesho's publicly stated 0% commission policy. The only recurring charges are the taxable shipping fee and the Meesho Mall Platform Fee (applicable only to Mall-tier SKUs). source_section: Table: Meesho Settlement — Table Knowledge Base
summary: Table: Meesho Settlement — Table Knowledge Base Schema: zsobserve Table: meeshosettlement Last Updated: April 2025 Maintained By: ZenStatement Data Team ---

1. Table Overview meeshosettlement is the financial settlement report exported from the Meesho Supplier Panel. It is the definitive source for seller payouts — recording the net amount remitted to the seller's bank account for each order, after all deductions (platform fees, freight, return logistics, TCS, TDS, penalties, claims). Each row represents one settled sub-order. Unlike other marketplaces, Meesho operates a 7-day payment cycle from delivery date (including COD), making this table the most timely financial reference. The invoicenumber field links to Meesho's formal GST invoice for the settlement. ---

1. Table Overview meeshosales is the forward-order OMS (Order Management System) table for Meesho. It captures every sub-order shipped from the seller to the buyer — including financial details (charged amount, tax, GST on fees, freight), geographic context (source/destination states), and product classification (HSN). It is the primary driver of GMV measurement and settlement reconciliation for forward transactions. Each row represents one sub-order line. Transaction type is either forward (sale) or cancelled.
